CheckCount.description: How many of the checks that applied passed.
CheckCount.title: CheckCount

CreateRequest.description: `POST /api/submissions`: the first round's files, and the dataset it is for.
CreateRequest.title: CreateRequest

DecisionRequest.description: `POST /api/submissions/{id}/decision`: a curator's decision and an optional note.
DecisionRequest.title: DecisionRequest

Event.description:
One audit event; the details present depend on `type`.

scanned: files, threats. checked: errors, warnings, notes, reportKey, blocked. held: files.
entered-review: rule, outcome, audience. reminded: day, audience. stale: days, audience.
decided: decision, note, selfReview. rejected: note. published: rule, datasetId, version.
abandoned and expired: days. failed: error.
Event.title: Event

Evidence.description:
The rows or values that show the problem or justify the change.

`count` is how many rows show it, since a problem on thousands of rows can't list them all.
Evidence.title: Evidence

Finding.description: One problem found in a package, by the rule with id `ruleId`.
Finding.title: Finding

FindingsReport.description:
The JSON at `reportUrl`: a round's checks. Both verdicts are null when the scan
blocked the round, and `quality` is null when the manifest can't be read.
FindingsReport.title: FindingsReport

HeldFile.description: A held file with a five-minute download link.
HeldFile.title: HeldFile

People.description: `GET /api/people`: each known id's email; unknown ids are left out.
People.title: People

QualityVerdict.description:
The counts of findings by severity from the last audit, and the completeness score.

`score` is the share of checks passed, as a whole percent rounded down; `find`,
`understand` and `trust` count the checks for each of the three questions.
QualityVerdict.title: QualityVerdict

ReviewPolicy.description:
The admin's review policy, the Settings item `review-policy`.

`rules` are tried in order and the first match wins; with no match the outcome is `one`
when `required` is true and `skip` when it is false. `reviewers` maps a theme to the
curators asked first. `reminders` are the days after entering review on which to remind,
each before `staleDays`, when a waiting review is marked stale.
ReviewPolicy.title: ReviewPolicy

Rule.description:
One policy rule. Every matcher it sets must hold; a rule that sets none matches all.

`submitters` lists user ids, or `curators` for the curator group; `themes` matches when
the submission has any of them.
Rule.title: Rule

Submission.description:
A submission as the API shows it.

`waiting` is true while the pipeline holds an open callback: a resubmit or a decision is
taken only then. `files` maps each round (as a string) to its files.
Submission.title: Submission

SubmissionRead.description: A submission, its events in order, and a link to its latest findings report.
SubmissionRead.title: SubmissionRead

SubmittedFile.description: One file of a round: a relative path, its size in bytes and its SHA-256 in hex.
SubmittedFile.title: SubmittedFile

Target.description: What a finding or a change is about: a resource and field, or a file in the package.
Target.title: Target

Upload.description: A presigned PUT: send the file to `url` with `headers`, or S3 refuses it.
Upload.title: Upload

UsageAnswers.description:
The three questions, each optional. Anything else is refused, so nothing identifying
can be stored by mistake.
UsageAnswers.title: UsageAnswers

ValidationVerdict.description: Whether the package is structurally valid, by which contract version, and when.
ValidationVerdict.title: ValidationVerdict
